Resource Profile: EReferralServiceRequestDiagnosticImaging

Official URL: https://www.riziv-inami.be/standards/fhir/ereferral/StructureDefinition/ereferral-servicerequest-diagnosticimaging Version: 3.0.0
Draft as of 2026-10-29 Computable Name: EReferralServiceRequestDiagnosticImaging

The diagnostic imaging profile. eReferral version.

ereferral-inv-urgency-justification-value-pseudonymized error ServiceRequest When urgencyJustification.valueString is present, it must have the be-ext-pseudonymization extension. extension.where(url = 'https://www.ehealth.fgov.be/standards/fhir/drp/StructureDefinition/be-ext-urgency-justification').value.ofType(string).all(extension.where(url = 'https://www.ehealth.fgov.be/standards/fhir/infsec/StructureDefinition/be-ext-pseudonymization').exists())
ereferral-inv-urgent-requires-urgency-justification error ServiceRequest The urgencyJustification extension must be present when priority is urgent. priority != 'urgent' or extension.where(url = 'https://www.ehealth.fgov.be/standards/fhir/drp/StructureDefinition/be-ext-urgency-justification').exists()
